title: Claude Code from your phone: 3 ways to run it on mobile
h1: claude code from your phone: three ways in
description: Run Claude Code from an iPhone or Android phone: Remote Control, cloud sessions or a dusk bot you text. Plans, pairing steps and what has to stay on.
answer: **yes, you can run claude code from your phone, three ways.** remote control reaches claude code on your own computer. anthropic cloud sessions run elsewhere, so the laptop can sleep. dusk lets you text a named bot that uses claude code, on iphone or android. as of 12 november 2026, all three exist. pick by where the work lives.

review.by: lead agent: independent reviewer pass against seo/facts (4 reviewers), every finding applied, automated gate

table.h: which computer is doing the work?
table.intro: **choose the host that will still be on when you need it.** anthropic details are as of 12 november 2026. dusk access depends on which host you pair with.

sections.h: remote control still needs the machine at your desk
sections.md:
**pick up the session you left running at your desk.** remote control connects claude.ai/code or the claude ios/android app to claude code on your own machine.[^1]

leave that computer on with the claude process running. after sleep or a lost network, it reconnects when the machine returns; work pauses during the gap.[^1]

as of 12 november 2026, remote control supports pro, max, ultra, team and enterprise. api-key sign-in is not supported. team and enterprise need an owner to enable it.[^1]

choose this for work that belongs on your desk computer. leave it powered and connected before heading out.

sections.h: cloud sessions leave the laptop out of the job
sections.md:
**close the laptop and let a cloud session keep working.** anthropic hosts it elsewhere, so you can read or steer it from another device.[^2]

start from the mobile **code** tab, claude.ai/code, desktop or `claude --cloud`. usage counts toward your plan limits. as of 12 november 2026, plans include pro, max, ultra, team and eligible enterprise seats.[^2]

cloud sessions clone your code from github. gitlab, bitbucket and other hosts come with restrictions, so read them before you rely on it.[^2]

try this for a coding session while travelling before renting another machine. repeating work is a separate decision; see the [claude schedules guide](/guides/claude-scheduled-tasks).

sections.h: dusk gives the work a named bot
sections.md:
**text the same teammate tomorrow, with its memory intact.** a dusk bot has a name, a job, its own chats and memory, and the ai you choose.[^4]

choose claude code and dusk runs that official command-line app where the bot lives. you complete the sign-in yourself.[^6]

keep planning and document review as separate jobs, with different memories or ais. changing a bot's ai keeps its chats, files and memory.[^4]

choose dusk for continuing work with a teammate you text. use remote control to reach a particular session.

sections.h: phone access does not change provider terms
sections.md:
**use your own sign-in in the unmodified claude code app.** anthropic's legal page, checked on 12 november 2026, permits that end-user setup.[^7]

it also sets conditions for platforms that host claude code.[^7] read the current terms for your setup. phone access keeps the same subscription rules and provider limits.

sections.h: what each route needs from your plan
sections.md:
**remote control and cloud sessions both need a paid claude plan.** as of 12 november 2026, remote control works on pro, max, ultra, team and enterprise. it does not work with an api key.[^1]

cloud sessions cover pro, max, ultra, team and eligible enterprise seats. their usage counts toward your plan limits.[^2]

dusk is free for personal use on your own computer. a bot can use your claude sign-in, or an anthropic api key under **settings**, **api keys**.[^6] your ai provider bills that usage, never dusk.[^9]

want the phone to work with your laptop off? dusk cloud plus is $20 a month or $200 a year.[^5]

sections.h: pair once, then text it from the couch
sections.md:
**scan the code and send your first message from the phone.** alternatives include a six-digit code, the nearby wi-fi list or tailscale. wi-fi and tailscale pairing need no account. secure pairing asks you to sign in by email.[^3]

on iphone, get dusk bot from the app store. on android, download the .apk from [the download page](/download); it is not on google play yet. either way, the app tells you when a reply, a question or an approval arrives. a notification shows the bot's name and “new message”, never the text.[^3]

your paired computer needs dusk running. **settings**, **remote access**, **keep this computer awake** helps it stay reachable. pair to dusk cloud for access with your own computer off.[^3][^5]

[overnight hosting](/run-claude-code-24-7) covers that choice. [telegram, discord and slack](/guides/claude-code-telegram-discord-slack) covers separate chat channels.

sections.h: use the small screen for small decisions
sections.md:
**get the next small decision off your desk.** ask for two assumptions to revisit in an attached proposal. have the bot leave the file alone. save the whole-document review for a bigger screen.

dusk approval cards can reach your phone. allow apps per bot, read only where enough. for app writes, say 'ask me before you change anything'.[^8]

read the preview before allowing a command or file change.[^8] if the phone makes it hard to read, wait until you can see it properly.

faq.q: can i use claude code on my phone?
faq.a: **yes, three ways, as of 12 november 2026.** remote control opens a claude code session running on your own computer from the claude app. cloud sessions run on anthropic infrastructure and start from the mobile code tab. dusk lets you text a named bot that uses claude code where the bot lives.[^1][^2][^3]

faq.q: does claude code remote control work with an api key?
faq.a: **no.** as of 12 november 2026, anthropic says remote control is for pro, max, ultra, team and enterprise plans, and api keys are not supported. team and enterprise need an owner to turn it on. a dusk bot can use an anthropic api key instead of a subscription.[^1][^6]

faq.q: why does it stop working when i leave my laptop?
faq.a: **the local host paused when you left it.** remote control needs the computer and claude process running. dusk paired to that computer needs dusk open too.[^1][^3]

faq.q: is there a dusk bot app for iphone and android?
faq.a: **yes.** on iphone, get dusk bot from the app store. on android, download the .apk from dusk.bot/download, because it is not on google play yet. the app tells you when a reply, question or approval arrives, and notifications show only the bot's name and “new message”.[^3]

faq.q: can i use claude code from my phone with my computer off?
faq.a: **yes, if the work runs somewhere else.** an anthropic cloud session keeps going after you close the laptop. a dusk bot on dusk cloud also answers with your computer off. remote control and dusk paired to your own computer both need that computer on.[^2][^3][^5]

mistakes.fix: leave the host powered on with the right app running.

tip.text: before packing the laptop, ask which computer is actually doing the work.
